WITH gender_counts AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
), shares AS (
  SELECT gender, invoice_count,
         1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM gender_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT gender, invoice_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT gender, invoice_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;
